question: Which country has played every FIFA Football World Cup since it began?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Brazil**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Brazil** is the only country that has participated in every FIFA Football World Cup since its inception in 1930.
 
• The FIFA World Cup is an international football competition contested by the men's national teams of the member associations of FIFA.
 
• Brazil is known for its rich football history and has won the World Cup a record five times.
 
• The country has produced many legendary football players, including Pelé, Zico, Romário, Ronaldo, and Neymar.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The first FIFA World Cup was held in 1930 in Uruguay, and it is held every four years.
 
• Brazil won its first World Cup in 1958, followed by victories in 1962, 1970, 1994, and 2002.
 
• The World Cup is one of the most widely viewed and followed sporting events in the world, with an estimated 3.5 billion people tuning in to watch the 2018 tournament.
 
• The tournament format involves a qualification phase, which takes place over the preceding three years, to determine which teams qualify for the tournament phase.
 
• The current format of the tournament involves 32 teams competing for the title at venues within the host nation(s) over a period of about a month.
